hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the roadway

hazards.name: Sidewalk encroachments
hazards.description: Planters and residential stairs on the right side narrow the effective walking width of the sidewalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side sidewalk

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: There are no designated crossing points visible, forcing pedestrians to cross mid-block without protection.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the visible block

hazards.name: Sidewalk debris and poor pavement
hazards.description: Litter and cracked sidewalk surfaces create minor tripping hazards and a less accessible environment.
hazards.location_in_image: Left sidewalk foreground

hazards.name: Lack of sidewalk buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is directly adjacent to the curb with no planting strip or furniture zone to separate pedestrians from traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the edge of the sidewalk.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Debris
hazards.description: Accumulated trash and litter on the walkway create minor trip hazards and degrade the pedestrian experience.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the foreground and midground sidewalk area.

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven concrete surfaces present a trip hazard for pedestrians, especially those with mobility impairments.
hazards.location_in_image: Visible throughout the sidewalk surface.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks marked crosswalks, increasing risk during street crossings.
hazards.location_in_image: Background intersection

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides of the narrow street obscures pedestrians, particularly children, from the view of oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs throughout the visible block.

hazards.name: Uneven Sidewalk Pavement
hazards.description: Significant cracking and vertical displacement between concrete sidewalk slabs create tripping hazards for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and midground sidewalk surface

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Install street trees to provide a physical buffer between the sidewalk and the street, while also narrowing the perceived roadway to slow traffic.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions at intersections to improve visibility and shorten the crossing distance for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Expand the width of the sidewalk to at least 5-6 feet to meet accessibility standards and improve pedestrian comfort.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the driveway to improve visibility for both drivers exiting the garage and pedestrians on the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Treatment
interventions.description: Maintain the sidewalk level and material across the driveway to signal pedestrian priority and slow down entering/exiting vehicles.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked crossings with high-visibility paint to designate safe areas for pedestrians to cross the roadway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Repair cracked and degraded sections of the sidewalk to ensure a smooth, accessible path for all users.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Maintenance
interventions.description: Repair cracked and uneven pavement sections to ensure a smooth, accessible surface for all users.

interventions.title: Designated Trash Storage
interventions.description: Implement designated areas or enclosures for trash bins to keep the public walkway clear of obstructions.

interventions.title: Street Tree Planting
interventions.description: Install street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and vehicles, while also providing shade.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during evening hours.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions or Planters
interventions.description: Introduce a buffer zone between the sidewalk and the roadway using planters or curb extensions to protect pedestrians from traffic.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement vertical traffic calming measures to ensure vehicle speeds remain low on this residential block.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Add street trees where space permits to provide a vertical buffer between the sidewalk and the street while improving the microclimate.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Replace the cracked and uneven concrete with a smooth, level surface to ensure ADA compliance and safety.

interventions.title: Regular Maintenance and Cleaning
interventions.description: Implement regular sanitation services to remove litter and debris that obstruct the pedestrian clear zone.

interventions.title: Clear Path Maintenance
interventions.description: Establish and enforce a minimum clear width for the sidewalk by managing the placement of planters and trash receptacles.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Install speed humps or cushions to ensure vehicle speeds remain low in this dense residential environment.

interventions.title: Raised Sidewalk and Curb
interventions.description: Install a standard raised sidewalk with a vertical curb to provide physical separation and protection for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Roadway and Walkway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repave the street and pedestrian areas to eliminate trip hazards and improve accessibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance and Repair
interventions.description: Repair cracked and uneven sidewalk sections to ensure a smooth, accessible surface for all users.
